releaseNotes: Added explicit Debit Card, Credit Card, and Loan account types with debt/asset net-worth accounting and one-tap Card/Loan repayments.
Fixed Scheduled & Planned Payments math (monthly calendar upcoming occurrences instead of double-counting paid/yearly bills, and + vs - formatting for scheduled income).
Implemented real Auto-Pay catch-up execution on due dates, Skip bill action, Overdue/Due Today status pills, and Account/Category/Start-Date controls.
